overloads.semanticRole: Sets the automatic/manual status of all Many-to-One/One-to-Many relations starting from every Many field of manyTable.

discriminatedBy.rule: First overload: first parameter is a Table -- applies to all relations starting from that table's Many fields.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the automatic/manual status of the single Many-to-One/One-to-Many relation starting from the specific manyField.

discriminatedBy.rule: Second overload: first parameter is a Field -- applies only to the relation starting from that specific Many field.

constraints: Sets automatic/manual relation status for the current process only, independent of the relation's design-time status.
If there is no relation starting from the given field/table, syntax error 16 is generated and OK is set to 0.
one/many values use the "Relations" theme constants: 0 = do not modify, 1 = use the structure configuration, 2 = manual, (and further documented values for automatic).
